exclusion: Subjects who decided as inappropriate cases to participate in the observational study by investigator
inclusion: Subjects who participated in the phase 1 clinical trial(Protocol No.: CS10BR05- MSA101) at 3 months after administering investigational product
Subjects who give a written, signed and dated informed consent spontaneously

official_title: Observational Study of Long-term Safety and Efficacy of Subjects Who Participated in CS10BR05 Inj. Phase 1 Study
summary: The study purpose is conducting follow-up surveillance for the incidence of adverse events and efficacy of subjects participated in phase 1 trial to evaluate the safety and tolerability of autologous bone marrow-derived mesenchymal stem cells (CS10BR05) in subjects with Multiple System Atrophy until 60 months from administering investigational product (IP).
title: Long-term Follow-up of Phase 1 Clinical Trial of CS10BR05(CS10BR05-MSA101)
